basic_details.job_title: CMP Degree College Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: C.M.P. Degree College, Prayagraj (Chaudhary Mahadev Prasad Mahavidyalaya), a constituent P.G. college of the University of Allahabad, has 11 Assistant Professor posts in Law, Political Science, Sociology, Computer Science and Statistics. The posts carry an entry pay of Rs 57700/- in Academic Level 10 of the Pay Matrix (7 CPC). The qualification is as per the UGC Regulations, 2018. Eligible Indian citizens can apply online on www.cmpcollege.ac.in from 17 November 2026 to 8 December 2026. The printed form must then reach the College by Speed Post on or before 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee has two parts: an application fee and a registration/processing fee. | Fee payment starts on 17.11.2026. The fee must be paid online only, through credit/debit card, Net Banking, UPI, etc. Application and registration/processing fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Applicants applying for more than one post must apply separately and pay the fees separately. Applications without the requisite fee will be rejected.

how_to_apply: Fill the application form on the Recruitment portal of the College website www.cmpcollege.ac.in. Give complete and correct information and attachments in the prescribed format.
Upload the reservation certificates if you claim SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD benefits. These certificates must be in the Union Government format and digitally verifiable.
Pay the fee online through credit/debit card, Net Banking, UPI, etc.
Complete online registration and final submission of the form by 08.12.2026.
Print the successfully submitted online application form and attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents/certificates.
Write on the envelope: "Application for the Post of Assistant Professor in [Subject]" vide Advt no: CMP/Rec./02/Asst. Prof./2026.
Send the envelope by Speed Post only to The Principal, C.M.P. Degree College, M.G. Marg, George Town, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh – 211002. It must reach the College on or before 15.12.2026.
Printed copy of the submitted online application form with self-attested copies of all relevant documents/certificates
Category certificate for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD claims, uploaded with the application
OBC (non-creamy layer) certificate of the current financial year, in the prescribed form, issued by the Competent Authority
Valid disability certificate showing a disability of not less than 40%, for PwBD applicants
Recent copy of the NOC, for candidates employed by Govt./Private Universities/Colleges/Autonomous bodies
Certificate from the concerned University that the Ph.D. degree complies with the relevant UGC Regulations

If the certificates for the reserved categories are not uploaded with the application, the application may be rejected, and no appeal against the rejection will be entertained. For persistent technical issues, applicants can email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About the College
content_sections.text: C.M.P. Degree College is a constituent P.G. college of the University of Allahabad. It is located on Mahatma Gandhi Marg, George Town, Prayagraj-211002, Uttar Pradesh, and its letterhead states that it is NAAC Accredited B++. Selection for these posts follows the UGC Regulations, 2018 and the Ordinances of the University of Allahabad.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The College has advertised 11 Assistant Professor posts in five subjects. The table below gives the category-wise and PwBD-wise break-up as printed in the notice. The PwBD categories in the notice are: Category (a): Blindness and low vision Category (b): Deaf and hard of hearing Category (c): Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy Category (d): Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness Category (e): Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (a) to (d) including deaf-blindness

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must hold the prescribed qualifications and experience as of the closing date of application. The posts are advertised with the broad areas of specialisation in each subject in mind. However, the concerned department may have specific requirements for specialisation. Applicants for the post of Assistant Professor must submit a certificate in the prescribed format from the concerned University stating that their Ph.D. degree complies with the relevant UGC Regulations for the award of the Ph.D. degree. Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS and PwBD categories will be as per UGC guidelines and Government of India rules. To claim PwBD benefits, the applicant's relevant disability should not be less than 40%. OBC applicants should belong to castes enlisted in the Central List for OBCs. Candidates must be in sound health. If selected, they must undergo a medical examination and satisfy the competent medical authority. The notice does not mention an age limit. For the subject-wise eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification and the UGC Regulations, 2018 it cites.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee has two parts: an application fee and a registration/processing fee. Fee payment starts on 17.11.2026. The fee must be paid online only, through credit/debit card, Net Banking, UPI, etc. Application and registration/processing fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Applicants applying for more than one post must apply separately and pay the fees separately. Applications without the requisite fee will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMP Degree College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form on the Recruitment portal of the College website www.cmpcollege.ac.in . Give complete and correct information and attachments in the prescribed format. Upload the reservation certificates if you claim SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD benefits. These certificates must be in the Union Government format and digitally verifiable. Pay the fee online through credit/debit card, Net Banking, UPI, etc. Complete online registration and final submission of the form by 08.12.2026. For persistent technical issues, applicants can email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Interview letters, if any, and all other correspondence will be sent only to the e-mail address given in the online application form. Shortlisted candidates must report with all testimonials/certificates in original and a valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License/Passport). At the interview, candidates must submit one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates on qualifications, experience and category, as applicable, duly certified by the applicant. Employed candidates must produce the original NOC at the interview. It must certify that (i) no vigilance case is pending or being contemplated against them, and (ii) they will be relieved within the stipulated time if selected. Consequential vacancies arising at the time of the interview may also be filled from the available shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid for attending interviews.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMP Degree College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 Assistant Professor posts: Law 2, Political Science 1, Sociology 1, Computer Science 5 and Statistics 2.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CMP Degree College Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 8 December 2026. The printed copy must reach the College by Speed Post on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for CMP Degree College Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per the UGC Regulations, 2018 (or as amended up to the date of advertisement). It must be held as of the closing date of application, and applicants must submit a certificate that their Ph.D. degree complies with UGC Regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of CMP Degree College Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The posts carry a rationalised entry pay of Rs 57700/- in Academic Level 10 of the Pay Matrix (7 CPC), with other admissible allowances as per UGC pay norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CMP Degree College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total fee is Rs 2500/- for UR, EWS and OBC, Rs 1500/- for SC/ST and Rs 500/- for PwBDs, paid online only. Fees are not refundable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CMP Degree College Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Apply online on the Recruitment portal of www.cmpcollege.ac.in by 8 December 2026. Then send the printed form with self-attested documents by Speed Post to The Principal, C.M.P. Degree College, M.G. Marg, George Town, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh – 211002, so it reaches by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CMP Degree College Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Applications will be screened under the UGC Regulations 2018 screening guidelines and the Ordinances of the University of Allahabad. Shortlisted applicants will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates who applied under the 2022 advertisement need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants under Advt. No. CMP/Rec./Asst.Prof./01/2022 must apply afresh and pay Rs 500/- as the registration/processing fee. Otherwise, their candidature will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one subject in CMP Degree College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants applying for more than one post must submit separate applications and pay the fees separately.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the CMP Degree College interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending interviews.
